summary: Deregister a custom self-service template by opening it from Templates as an administrator, choosing Unregister Template, confirming, and clicking Delete Entity; the template then disappears from the Templates view.
questions: How do I delete a custom template from self-service automation portal?
How do I verify a self-service template was deregistered?

answer_card.title: Deregister a custom self-service template
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Log in to self-service automation portal as an administrator and open **Templates**.
2. Click the custom template to open **Template detail**.
3. Click **Unregister Template** in the navigation bar and confirm.
4. Click **Delete Entity**.

Check the **Templates** view to confirm it is gone.
